title: Split Pea Soup

steps.text: Heat the water and peas to a boil in a Dutch oven; boil 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, cover, and let stand 1 hour.
Stir the ham, onion, and spices into the peas.

notes: Recipe from Jean. Serves 8 (1 1/2 cups each). The written method ends after stirring in the ham, onion, and spices; the carrots and celery are not mentioned in it.
